rationale: Round-2 duty (confirm round-1 basis; judge the fix commits' new tests): CONFIRMED at tip 0783a507. (1) Round-1 AC-map basis fully re-verified at the new tip. The fix commits touch AC-pinned production surfaces (derive.go, complete.go + materialize.go, approve/spec.go, next/select.go + beads.go, repair.go, state.go, spec.go), so I re-ran the basis rather than assuming: all seven unit-basis packages pass -short at tip (internal/phase, internal/complete 67s, internal/approve 47s, internal/next, internal/bead, internal/resolve, internal/instruct 65.6s); 38 cmd-level named round-1 pins re-run green (state-show honesty, repair backward/force/concurrent legs, AC5viii sanction boundary, frozen-contract cobra pin, all TestVerbOutput_* rows + total classification, completeTail branches, plus the NEW TestSpecApprove_TailStatesCommittedResultNotFalseInstruction and final_review_render tests); the three heaviest cmd selection pins re-run green at tip against the rewritten select.go (TestNextSelection_EmitOnlyPickParity_DifferentBeadsPerPick, _PositionalExcludedByFilter_NamesReason, _AllExcludedByFilter_LoudError — AC-9/AC-10/AC-10b's letters hold through the G4 rewrite); the flagged round-1 suites re-run green (AC-4b indeterminate set, AC-16 backfill set with wiring re-confirmed at internal/approve/spec.go:96, TestRoute248_* both routes, TestMindspecPhaseWritesAllLockGuarded, TestDerivePhase_AC5iv_*). AC-2's integrity specifically: 0783a507 edits project-docs/user/guides/lifecycle-modes.md, but the delta is prose/citation-anchoring only (function-name anchors replacing stale line cites, per G7) — no table cell changed — and TestAgreementTable_Rows (all 13 row subtests) + TestAgreementTable_DocRowsCrossPinFixtures pass at tip, so the cross-pin held rather than being edited around. (2) The new tests genuinely pin their claims — spot-run as directed, all PASS. Leg xxiv (TestBead6Leg_xxiv_ForgedMarkerAndTrailerNeverResumePastGates) is R6's executed spoof verbatim: a porcelain-authored commit with a clean Mindspec-Stage trailer carrying an unowned file, published by hand `git update-ref`, with fixture-sanity proving the forgery structurally perfect — and it asserts all four consequences (adr-divergence refusal from the NORMAL run, forged marker cleared FOREIGN, spec branch tip byte-unchanged, smuggled file absent from the spec branch), driven through the real Run() over real git. The five TestDiscriminator_* legs + TestStageAttestationSeamDefaults pin the attestation design's letter: attested resumes, unattested/mismatched clears FOREIGN, read-failure propagates (no fail-open), and the unattested-parent leg never advances the branch. The four derive_swallow regressions are genuine, not decorative: they drive the exact partial-outage shape (epic reads healthy, `bd list --parent` failing) through the real cache seams and assert error propagation with NO phase returned (both no-stored-phase arms), warning suppression when no derivation ran (the stored-phase arm — the correct honest companion to AC-5(iv), not a contradiction of it), and DiscoverActiveSpecs propagation (closing the false-idle serialization risk). These extend the spec's AC-4b/R2.3 discovery-failure-is-never-a-mode class into derive.go itself — they strengthen the AC surface and introduce no renumbering, no swapped attribution, and no map drift. (3) Round-1's confidence caveat is now closed: my independent full-tree `go test ./... -short` completed EXIT 0 and the full no-short cmd/mindspec selection/claim-guard suite completed exit 0 (both at the round-1 tip), and the addendum's tip-suite record (-short 48/48, no-short cmd PASS, -race x5) is consistent with everything I executed at 0783a507. One environmental note, not a finding against the branch: in one combined seven-package sweep internal/instruct hit go test's 600s per-binary timeout with an os/exec io.Copy stall; re-run standalone it passes in 65.6s, and neither fix commit touches internal/instruct — machine contention from the concurrent panel probes, recorded here so a future gate log reader does not mistake the same signature for a regression. My three round-1 minor findings stand as recorded (BRIEF map filename imprecisions; leg xi's missing in-file AC-7 label; the gate.go wording edit vs the 'untouched under OQ-1(a)' letter) — all were no-change-required notes and none is worsened by the fix commits.
